messages:
Amara (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize DP candidate prioritization and rollout gates for the private beta. I sketched a lightweight impact matrix and suggested rollout gates. Goal: pick 6 partners, staggered over 3 waves. Thoughts?

Luca (Eng): +1 on 3 waves. Can we add an infra-risk column? some partners will need private VPC + larger model variants.

Priya (Research): Suggest scoring by 4 axes: product-fit, expected TTV delta, data-sensitivity (privacy), and implementation effort. Weight product-fit and TTV more.

Jordan (Customer Success): From CS side — prioritize partners with a single POC owner and clear success metric (e.g., reduction in manual triage time). Also prefer those willing to run weekly async feedback.

Devon (Data): We can run a quick signal check on usage surface area from their current tools to estimate traffic. Will need CSV with candidate app endpoints.

Amara (PM): Proposed impact matrix (short):
- Product-fit (0-5)
- Expected TTV reduction % (0-5)
- Privacy constraints (0-3) lower is more sensitive
- Implementation effort (0-5) higher = more work
- Infra risk flag (yes/no)

Scoring rule: prioritize by weighted sum = 0.4*product-fit + 0.4*TTV + 0.1*(5-privacy) + 0.1*(5-effort) and filter out infra-risk=yes for wave1.

Luca (Eng): That filter makes sense. For wave1 we should only include partners who don't require on-prem/HSM or bespoke quantization. Wave2 can include medium infra risk.

Priya (Research): Also add a quality-regression acceptance gate: candidate must agree to a small prompt-eval suite (20 prompt families) and accept automatic rollback if mean quality drops > 6% vs control.

Jordan (Customer Success): Can we require a beta commitment: 8-week engagement, one dedicated PM from their side, and weekly feedback meeting + 2 async surveys? Otherwise we mark as low-touch and put them in a later wave.

Amara (PM): Rollout gates (proposed):
1) Legal & data NDA signed (baseline)
2) Candidate score >= 3.5 (weighted)
3) Performance SLO: p95 latency < 600ms for 2k QPS test or agreed baseline with partner
4) Eval pass: quality regression <= 6% on agreed prompt set
5) Observability: partner routes logs/metrics or agrees to agent instrumentation

Devon (Data): For the scoring sheet I'll add columns for current MAU and typical request size so we can estimate token costs and SRE impact.

Amara (PM): Candidate outreach language draft: "We are running a small private beta focused on [feature]. We'll prioritize partners who can provide product-side metrics and run a short eval. Committed engagement = faster rollout & dedicated engineering support." Thoughts?

Luca (Eng): Make sure to call out "no on-prem required for wave1" in outreach. Also mention telemetry requirements upfront.

Jordan (Customer Success): I'll prepare a short checklist for partners (commitment, data access, success metric, contact info). Should reduce back-and-forth.

Priya (Research): One more — in the intro doc include the eval appendix with 3 example prompts and how we'll measure regressions. Transparency helps partners opt-in.

Amara (PM): Action items: 
- Devon: add MAU/request-size columns to the candidate sheet and run initial signal checks (due EOD Thu).
- Jordan: draft partner checklist and outreach email (due Tue).
- Luca: confirm infra-risk definitions and wave1 compatibility checklist (due Wed).
- Priya: assemble eval prompt set and pass/fail criteria (due Fri).
- Amara: consolidate final selection rubric and run first cut next Monday.

Devon (Data): noted. I’ll tag candidates with an estimated monthly token footprint.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled beta-invite-email rollout job set for 1900070000 will run only after manual approval.

Amara (PM): Cool — if we all hit these mini-dates we can lock wave1 by next Tuesday. If anyone has strong objections to the 6-partner cap, raise now. Otherwise I’ll finalize the sheet and send the outreach draft. :thumbsup:
